journey.name: contact pay private link pending
journey.description: A saved contact that supports private payments is only paid privately. While the private connection with that contact is still being set up, Pay explains that and opens no payment, instead of paying the contact's public payment details; once both sides have saved each other, Pay works again. Requires two disposable Bitkit identities with contact payment sharing enabled. The second identity publishes public payment endpoints and must not have the first identity saved or linked. The message is a toast, which the UI tree does not expose: read it from a screenshot taken right after the tap. No payment is sent.

actions.action: On the first device, open Contacts and add the second identity by its Pubky key

Verify the Add Contact notice reads "Please note that you and <name> must add each other as contacts before you can pay each other privately. If you pay without saving, the payment is visible publicly."
Save the contact and verify the contact's detail screen opens with the second identity's name and Pay (testTag "ContactPay")
Open the saved contact from Contacts and tap Pay (testTag "ContactPay")

Verify the send amount screen (testTag "send_amount_screen") does not open and a toast titled "Unable To Pay Contact" reads "Bitkit is still setting up a private connection with this contact. Make sure they've added you as a contact too, or ask them to send you a payment request."
Open Send and choose Contact, tap the second identity's row and verify the same toast appears, no amount screen opens and contact selection becomes available again
On the second device, open Contacts, add the first identity by its Pubky key, save it and keep Bitkit open in the foreground

On the first device, open the saved contact from Contacts and tap Pay; if the Request or Pay sheet (testTag "RequestOrPaySheet") appears, tap Pay on the sheet. If the private connection message appears instead of a payment, close any payment flow without paying and retry after 5 seconds, and keep retrying every 5 seconds
Verify the send amount screen (testTag "send_amount_screen") opens; record the elapsed time, or report a failure if it does not open during the run
Close the payment flow without paying
